# Version 4.156.2 (Unreleased)
> **Filtered glyph correctness**

## Highlights

Upcoming servicing fixes make mask-filtered glyph rendering safer when consecutive font-scaler loads disagree.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Reloaded glyphs use their own rendering state** — Mask filtering uses the reloaded glyph's path and copies overlap only between matching byte-per-pixel masks. Full plane strides are preserved for clipped embossed glyphs, avoiding stale outlines, sub-byte buffer overwrites and corrupted or uncleared mask planes. Managed bindings are unchanged. ([#5742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5742))
